event.title: SFSCON'26 - 'I care, therefore I tech: getting those that make digital go round to care' in Bolzano, Italy in Bolzano, Italy

body.p: The FSFE Volunteer, Lorenzo Lin Angeli, will share key insights from his practice as a scholar, teacher, hacktivist and creative practitioner on how to “sensitise” those that engage deeply with technologies — especially students in computing disciplines — to the social and planetary impacts of their practices. Also, aside from sharing his research, teaching, and insights, he will invite participants to join in a structured conversation on sharing practices of care, and on imagining concrete actions that computing practitioners could do to reimagine their actions under a lens of care.
The talk will be in English and it will take place in the Seminar 3.
